definitions.explanation: A reduction in the price of goods or services.

examples.japanese: {値引|ねび}き⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらえますか→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: Can you give me a discount?

examples.japanese: {値引|ねび}き⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{値引|ねび}き means a reduction in price. Formed from ⟦{値|ね}→値：03527_ne⟧ (price) + ⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to pull/reduce).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {値引|ねび}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to discount
- {値引|ねび}き⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to get a discount
- {値引|ねび}き⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧: price negotiation
- ⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧{値引|ねび}き: significant discount
- {値引|ねび}き⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: discounted price

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧: discount (often percentage-based; 10%⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧)
- ⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧: sale (general retail event)
- ⟦{特価|とっか}→特価：18798_tokka⟧: special price
- ⟦{安売|やすう}り→安売り：07779_yasuuri⟧: bargain sale

USAGE:
{値引|ねび}き usually implies negotiating a lower price, while ⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧ is a pre-set reduction (coupon, membership, etc.).
